articles.title: Hyderabad ventilator tender faces corruption allegations
articles.description: HYDERABAD: Allegations of irregularities have surfaced in the tender process for procuring ventilators for government hospitals in Telangana. Officials in the corporation are accused of manipulating the process to ensure that contracts go to favoured companies. articles.title: TN govt secures price cut in free bicycles for students after negotiations
articles.description: Chennai, Nov 14 (PTI) Following intense negotiations with the manufacturer, the Tamil Nadu government has secured a substantial reduction in the procurement cost of free bicycles for government school students, slashing prices by over 27 per cent for boys and nearly 32 per cent for girls. articles.title: VA Tech Wabag's ₹2,332 crore Saudi order cancelled; company seeks clarity
articles.description: Saudi Water Authority has cancelled VA Tech Wabag's ₹2,332 crore Yanbu desalination project tender due to internal reasons. The development comes after the company had received the award and completed contract formalities in July 2025.
